name: @liqweed/motion-kit
description: Deterministic animated diagrams: scenes as pure functions of time, for live pages, slides, baked SVG and video.
author: Ophir Radnitz

scripts.check: node cli/motion-kit.mjs check examples/order-flow.json examples/smart-home.json examples/release-pipeline.json examples/agent-loop.json examples/integrations.json examples/incident.json examples/web-stack.json examples/custom-pulse.scene.mjs examples/isometric-swivel.scene.mjs examples/text-reveal.scene.mjs brand/logo.scene.mjs examples/player-states.json examples/checkout.json examples/connection.json examples/pull-request.json
scripts.gate:core: npm run -s typecheck && npm run -s versions && npm test && npm run -s check && npm run -s media:check
scripts.gate: npm run -s gate:core && npm run -s site
scripts.skills:design: DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@1.9.0 experimental_install --frozen-lockfile -a claude-code -a codex
